meta.title: A Model House with a Light

paragraphs: Posted by Lily. Leo and Mia made a model house for the school open day. It has three rooms, a garage, and a small electric light. Now other children want to make one, so here are the instructions. An adult must help you with the electric parts. The house is small, but it is very nice.

First, get everything that you need. You need a big box, some cardboard, glue, and a pair of scissors. You also need three small matchboxes, a piece of sponge, and a paper tube. For the light, you need a small battery, two pieces of wire, and a small bulb. Get some red paper for the heating.

Step one is to make the rooms. Cut a door and two windows in the front of the big box. Be careful with the scissors. Next, cut two walls from the cardboard. Glue the walls inside the box, and make three rooms. Let the glue dry for ten minutes. The first room is the bedroom, the second room is the kitchen, and the third room is the bathroom.

Step two is to make the small furniture. For the bedroom, make a bed from cardboard, and cut a small piece of sponge for the pillow. For the kitchen, open one matchbox a little, and it becomes a drawer. For the bathroom, cut the paper tube in half, and glue one half on the floor. That is your toilet. Do not forget to paint everything with bright colors. Mia painted the roof green.

Step three is to make the garage. Take another small box and glue it to the right side of the house. Cut a wide door in the front of the garage. Put a small toy car inside to check the size. The car must go in easily. Then make the heating from the red paper, and glue it under a window.

Step four is the electric light, and an adult must do it with you. First, make a small hole in the roof of the bedroom. Put the bulb in the hole, and join each wire to the bulb. Then join the other end of each wire to the battery. The light comes on when the wires touch the battery. Finally, turn off the light, and show your model house to your friends. Did your light come on the first time?
